prompt: A watercolor illustration depicts a lush botanical greenhouse filled with vibrant flora and distinct characters. On the left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands holding a silver watering can, her posture upright as she tends to the plants. Next to her, a small green parrot perches on a wooden railing, its feathers bright against the muted background. In the center, an elderly man with a white beard sits on a rustic wooden bench, his hands resting gently on his knees. Beside him, a tabby cat curls up comfortably, sleeping peacefully on the slats of the bench. To the right, a young boy in blue overalls points excitedly at a large fern, his finger extended toward the fronds. Standing next to the boy, a woman in a floral dress looks at the same fern, her head tilted in curiosity. Behind them, a tall glass vase filled with water sits on a metal table, reflecting the soft light. A brown dog lies on the tiled floor near the table, its tail wagging slightly. Above the scene, hanging from the ceiling beams, is a woven basket containing trailing ivy. Near the entrance, a gardener in a straw hat holds a pair of pruning shears, ready to trim a nearby bush. The interaction between the boy and the woman shows a shared moment of discovery as he points and she looks. The woman in the yellow raincoat interacts with the plants by watering them, while the cat rests next to the elderly man. There is no electronic equipment visible in the scene. There is no modern furniture present, only rustic wooden and metal elements.
